tool.description: Tool name, used as prefix for generated function names

cwd.description: Working directory: 'default', 'git-root', or an explicit path

shell.description: Shell to use for command execution (default: /bin/bash)

name.description: Command name, combined with tool name for the function name

command.description: Command template with ${var} placeholders. Built-in vars: ${file}, ${file-relative}, ${dir}

inputs.description: Declared user inputs for template variables that need prompting

prompt.description: Prompt text shown to user (default: capitalized variable name)

choices.description: Static list of choices for completing-read

command.description: Shell command whose output lines become completion candidates (for type: shell)

optional.description: If true, empty input removes the placeholder from the command

stdin.description: Source for stdin input. 'region' uses selected text (or buffer if no selection). 'buffer' always uses entire buffer.

output.description: Output mode: 'terminal' (default) runs in eat/term, 'buffer' shows in read-only buffer, 'replace' replaces stdin source text
